open_items: ECB: a live recheck of its direct endpoint about 40 minutes after cycle 1348 (which itself saw ECB fully healthy with good latencies) got no response at all across three attempts (TLS connects, request sent, then nothing for 25-60s, not an HTTP error), while OECD and ILO direct answered fine in the same window. Not yet reflected in any monitor cycle. Watch the next cycle (due ~14:01 UTC); if it also shows ECB failing or stale, treat it as a new problem distinct from the chronic empty-error-body bug.

STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 1348 (no change in this cycle's /api/contracts changes, which only lists ILO and OECD encoding:structure_xml). Still open, not re-reported since no new change.
claude/ triage branches on origin: 160 as of this run (159 last run), still well above the 20 the skill flags for pruning; not actioned by this read-only routine.

Monitor bug noted previously and reconfirmed: /api/history computes status without contracts, so a contract-only degraded state never shows up in /api/history, only in /api/status and /api/contracts. Confirmed again this run: ILO's status was healthy at 1348 per /api/history while its encoding:structure_xml contract assertion was still 403/skipped in that same cycle's /api/contracts snapshot (cleared by the time of the live recheck).

Chronic gateway bug (empty 'Error: ' message from tools/sdmx_tools.py around lines 207-209 catching Exception with an empty str(e)): previously traced on ABS (many occurrences), ESTAT (cycle 1143, 1335), and ECB (cycle 1337, 1339-adjacent, 1345). Not fixed by this routine; it only commits to docs/monitor/.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ECB does not support /availableconstraint/ (404 is expected, not an error); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); IMF direct json check is skipped by design (IMF ignores the JSON Accept header and returns XML); STATSNZ direct json check is skipped by design (Stats NZ ignores the JSON Accept header and returns CSV); BIS/ILO/IMF references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped); encoding:structure_xml Content-Type charset/version parameter order flips cosmetically from time to time across ABS/FBOS/ILO/SBS/OECD, verdict stays ok as always; ILO's direct path has a recurring Cloudflare/WAF 403 flakiness pattern that usually self-clears within one to a few cycles (the cycle 1342-1345 occurrence ran 4 cycles, the longest on record, but still cleared by 1346).
